text.p: A penniless British tramp has inherited 25,000 pounds ($37,500) from a sister living in the United States who he last saw three decades ago.
Joseph Martin, 65, was presented with the money after a lengthy transatlantic search tracked him down, via a notice in a local newspaper, to the county of Wiltshire in western England.
Martin, a former baker who has spent the last two years living rough and working on farms, said he was too shocked by his new-found fortune to know what to spend it on.
"I am sad to find Ella has died and shocked to find out she has left me so much money," said Martin. "I haven't seen her since she came over here in the 1960s."
